data.name: Abudah
data.long_meaning: The name Abudah is a combination of two words: ‘Abu’ and ‘Dah’. ‘Abu’ means ‘father’ or ‘servant’ of and ‘Dah’ is an Arabic term which means ‘Allah’. So, Abudah means ‘Servant of Allah’.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing dedication and devotion to Allah.
data.numerology_meaning: Persons with the name Abudah are loving, altruistic, and generous. They have an artistic nature and are often spiritual.
